issue: A2-A5 established pre-outcome SIGNAL and ENTRY evidence, but there was no canonical deterministic builder for the weekly RESULT payload. Without one, a future result could again depend on an unversioned/manual replay artifact, reproducing the auditability weakness discovered in the historical +7.3356%/+7.3914% validation print.
correction: Add checksum-verified raw Binance price and funding collectors plus a deterministic result builder. The result builder reparses the preserved raw archives, validates exact sealed holdings/instruments/dates, recomputes per-asset returns and frozen weights, recomputes funding events/rates from raw archives, applies the frozen cost formula and derives BTC benchmark return before the existing RESULT_SEAL validator is invoked.

price_contract.source: Binance Data Vision daily 1d kline archives
price_contract.long_venue: Binance Spot exact instrument sealed at ENTRY
price_contract.short_venue: Binance USD-M exact instrument sealed at ENTRY
price_contract.exit_close: exactly seven UTC days after entry daily close

funding_contract.source: Binance Data Vision USD-M fundingRate archives
funding_contract.event_window: strictly after entry-Friday close through exit-Friday close
funding_contract.portfolio_application: 0.05 * sealed exposure * raw funding_rate_sum per selected short; positive funding benefits short

result_contract.holdings: exactly the 10 longs and 10 shorts in V16B_ENTRY_SEAL

tests: complete 20-asset economics reconstruct and pass the existing RESULT_SEAL validator
manifest close tampering is detected by reparsing raw kline ZIP
funding CSV rate tampering is detected by reparsing raw funding archive
tampered raw funding archive is rejected
reason_no_new_candidate_id: The amendment makes the already-frozen result calculation reproducible before the first prospective observation. It changes evidence provenance and recomputation only, not any economic decision or formula.
